title: What each criterion can still show, per model, before the held-out evaluation
task: Final-phase plan A2; review section 8, item 7; spec section 5.2 (amendment of 10 November 2026); model-method sections 6.19, 6.19a, 6.23
scope: Primary encoder (OpenCLIP), spiking feedforward networks, the frozen configuration. Every criterion is still computed and reported for every model; this table says only how much the held-out run can add to it. It changes no criterion, setting or decision rule.

statuses.built_in: Follows from the model's construction (gate values, fitted c, identical input); met or not met for any network that facilitates on the full body
statuses.calibrated: A development step was tuned against this quantity on training sources (model-method 6.10-6.12)
statuses.previewed: Not tuned, but already measured on each network's unseen inner source or on its training sources; the held-out run repeats it on new images
statuses.open: Depends on a display never simulated for this model before the evaluation; a genuine out-of-sample test
statuses.not_scored: The criterion is not computed for this model (spec 5.2: S3 is H2's criterion)

criteria.P2_FB: Full-body half of P2: delta(FB, FDI) > 0, interval excluding 0
criteria.P2_UL: Upper-limb half of P2: delta(UL, FDI) > 0, interval excluding 0
criteria.P3: C_FDI positive in at least 80% of initialisations
criteria.S1: delta(DH)/mean[delta(FB), delta(UL)] inside the human interval [-0.67, 0.38]
criteria.S3a: H2 exceeds the visible-area model on both matched control pairs
criteria.S3b: Hand-only input (H0) does not meet P1 and H2's C_FDI exceeds it

h2.role: Primary model: attachment (forearm continuity) gate, c fitted to the human ratio

P1.why: a = 1, 1, 0 for full body, upper limb and detached hand in all 20 sources and c = 0, so delta(DH) = 0; C_FDI > 0 whenever delta(FB) + delta(UL) > 0

P2_FB.why: Full-body facilitation on unseen inner sources was the target of the readout and motor-regime development

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

P3.why: Follows from delta(DH) = 0 in every initialisation

S1.why: delta(DH) = 0 gives ratio 0, inside the interval; c was fitted to this ratio (a fit check, not a prediction)

S2.why: Needs the upper limb; no upper-limb data enter the fit

S3a.why: H2's pair differences were positive in 20 of 20 inner sources (stub - gap stub +1.42, arm - hand window +0.30); at c = 0 the visible-area gate gives both pair members about 0.03-0.06

S3b.why: H0's context effect is 0 by construction, so it cannot meet P1, and H2's C_FDI exceeds it whenever P1 holds

h2_cplus.role: Sensitivity analysis outside the decision rule: H2 at c+ (median 0.45)

P1.why: c+ keeps the training-source ratio delta(DH)/delta(FB) inside [-0.67, 0.35], so C_FDI > 0 unless delta(UL) is small

P2_FB.why: The same networks as H2; the gate is 1 on the full body

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

P3.why: Per-network training-source ratios at c+ are known

S1.why: c+ is defined as the largest c keeping the training-source ratio inside the human interval

S3a.why: S3 is scored for H2 at its declared c only

S3b.why: S3 is scored for H2 at its declared c only

ungated.role: Necessity comparison: H2's trained network with g = 1 on every display

P1.why: Training-source ratio delta(DH)/delta(FB) 0.49 (median), so C_FDI > 0 unless delta(UL) is near 0 or negative

P2_FB.why: The same networks as H2; g = 1 on the full body for both

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

S1.why: The training-source ratio is outside the human interval in 94% of networks (DINOv2: inside in 100%)

area.role: S3(a) low-level model: visible-area gate, c fitted by the same procedure

P1.why: Its fit curve gives the training-source ratio at its fitted c (c = 0 in OpenCLIP networks)

P2_FB.why: Full-body trials of the training sources were simulated in the fit

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

S1.why: Its c was fitted to this ratio on training sources

S3a.why: The comparison side of H2's S3(a); its control effects were not simulated before the evaluation

h2_learned.role: Comparison: learned forearm-prediction gate, c fitted as for H2

P1.why: Its fit curve (cross-fitted estimates) gives the training-source ratio at its fitted c

P2_FB.why: Full-body trials of the training sources were simulated in the fit

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

S1.why: Its c was fitted to this ratio on training sources

h4.role: Comparison: own-body familiarity gate, c fitted as for H2

P1.why: Its fit curve (cross-fitted estimates) gives the training-source ratio at its fitted c

P2_FB.why: Full-body trials of the training sources were simulated in the fit

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

S1.why: Its c was fitted to this ratio on training sources

h0.role: Comparison, no human data: hand-only input, identical in every display

P1.why: The input is the same hand-only image in every display, so C_FDI is 0 in expectation and P1 is not met except by chance

P2_FB.why: Facilitation on the inner source is part of the health check

P2_UL.why: The upper-limb input equals the full-body input, so it repeats P2_FB up to trial noise

P3.why: C_FDI is 0 in expectation in every initialisation

S1.why: Equal effects give a ratio near 1, outside the interval

S2.why: Equal effects give a ratio near 1, inside the interval

S3b.why: H0 is the comparison side of H2's S3(b)

h1.role: Comparison, no human data: salience gate g = 1 + s/s_bar, no fitted parameter

P1.why: Neither the upper limb nor the detached hand has been simulated for H1 (Gate 2 ran only the controls and the full-body sweep)

P2_FB.why: Facilitation on the inner source is part of the health check

P2_UL.why: The upper limb has never been simulated

P3.why: Needs the upper limb and the detached hand

S1.why: Needs the detached hand and the upper limb; a prediction for H1 (no human data)

S2.why: Needs the upper limb; a prediction for H1

configurations.note: Comparison configurations are scored as H2 and as the ungated network (no H0/H1, so no S3); their statuses follow the h2 and ungated rows with these differences.
configurations.h2_openclip_rate: Non-spiking twin: c = 0 (median), so H2's P1, P3, S1 are built in; its full-body facilitation is previewed, not calibrated; ungated ratio 0.37, inside the human interval in 43% of networks (S1 previewed)
configurations.h2_openclip_snn_rec: Recurrent variant: as the primary; ungated ratio 0.53
configurations.robustness_variations: Time constants, step, learning rate, width, updates: as the primary; ungated ratios 0.28-0.64
configurations.h2_openclip_snn_allctx: All-context training: c = 0, so H2's P1, P3, S1 stay built in; ungated ratio 1.14, outside the human interval in every network (S1 previewed as not met). Its training included upper-limb images of the 18 training sources, so P2_UL and S2 on the held-out source are open but not out of distribution
configurations.dinov2_encoders: Robustness encoders: only P1 enters the decision rule. H2's c is arbitrary for DINOv2 mean patch (flat curve) and the ungated ratio is already inside the interval (0.00-0.04), so the gate is inert there
